MP Cabinet Approves Rural Service for Doctors, IT Hubs, and MSP Auctions

The Madhya Pradesh cabinet has approved several key decisions, including a mandatory three-year rural service for doctors. Additionally, the state will establish IT hubs in districts and auction produce procured under the Minimum Support Price (MSP). These measures aim to improve healthcare access in rural areas and boost the state's digital infrastructure and agricultural economy.
